title.text: Dubai Marina, Atlantis, Palm and Burj Al Arab Speedboat Tour

pills.label: 90 minutes
pills.pop_html: Timing: A 1.5-hour round trip from Dubai Marina; check availability for start times. A safety briefing comes first, after check-in.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Language: A live guide in English points out each landmark and runs the safety briefing before you leave the marina.

pills.label: Ages 5+
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not open to children under 5, pregnant women, or people with mobility impairments or heart problems. Flat shoes or sandals recommended.

pills.label: Palm and Atlantis
pills.pop_html: Route: Through the marina, up the coast past Ain Dubai, Jumeirah Beach and Dubai Harbour, then along the Palm Jumeirah to Atlantis The Palm.

pills.label: Burj Al Arab
pills.pop_html: Turnaround: The tour also passes the private island of Dubai's rulers and reaches the Burj Al Arab before heading back to the marina.

pills.label: Photo stops
pills.pop_html: On board: The boat stops at the main sights for photos. Bottled water and professional life jackets are included.

pills.label: Fast but scenic
pills.pop_html: Vibe: An open speedboat with plenty of photo stops: a sightseeing ride with bursts of speed between landmarks, not a race.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want Ain Dubai, Atlantis and the Burj Al Arab from the water in one 90-minute ride, because it is the most-reviewed speedboat on this page and costs €37
best_for.skip_html: if you are travelling with children under 5 or want food and drinks on board (a shared yacht suits you better)

items.a: Speedboat sightseeing cruise, guide, bottled water, life jackets.
Hotel pickup and drop-off.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Xclusive Yachts Boarding Point, Marina Level, Al Majara, Al Hubob St, Dubai Marina.
Flat shoes or sandals, sunglasses, sunscreen, light clothes, snacks if you wish.

title.text: Dubai Marina Luxury Yacht Tour with Breakfast or BBQ Option

pills.label: 1, 2 or 3 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: Choose a morning cruise with breakfast or a sunset cruise with BBQ. Arrive 30 minutes early to use the departure lounge with free Wi-Fi.

pills.label: EN, FR, DE
pills.pop_html: Language: Live guide and optional audio guide in English, French and German, the widest choice among the yachts here.

pills.label: Not wheelchair-friendly
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not suitable for wheelchair users. Life jackets are on board for anyone who wants one.

pills.label: 65 ft+ yachts
pills.pop_html: The boat: Shared yachts of 65 feet and up, with an open upper deck in sun and shade and an air-conditioned lower lounge.

pills.label: Breakfast or BBQ
pills.pop_html: Food: Light breakfast on the morning option, BBQ on the 2-hour and 3-hour options. The 1-hour cruise has water and tropical drinks only.

pills.label: Marina to Burj Al Arab
pills.pop_html: Route: 1 hour: Dubai Marina, Ain Dubai, JBR and Dubai Harbour. Longer options add the Palm, Atlantis and the Burj Al Arab.

pills.label: Relaxed sunset deck
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Calm and social rather than fast: a red-carpet welcome and drinks on deck. Smart casual dress, no shoes on board.

best_for.pick_html: for couples, families and groups who want a calm, shaded cruise with a drink and the option of a BBQ, because the 1-hour version starts at €23 and it is the most-reviewed yacht tour on this page
best_for.skip_html: if you need the Burj Al Arab on a 1-hour budget (the short route turns at Dubai Harbour), or if you want to swim

items.a: Shared yacht cruise, guide, captain, life jackets, air-conditioned lounge with Wi-Fi, water and tropical drinks; light breakfast or BBQ if that option is chosen.
Hotel pickup, swimming, alcoholic drinks from the bar, food on the 1-hour option.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Xclusive Yachts Boarding Point, Marina Level, Al Majara, Al Hubob St, Dubai Marina.
Passport or ID card.

title.text: Dubai Marina 1.5-Hour Atlantis Sightseeing Speedboat Tour

pills.pop_html: Timing: 90-minute rides with departures across the day, from 9:00 in the morning to 19:45 in the evening, so sunset slots are easy to find.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Language: Live English-speaking guide who points out the landmarks; several guests mention the guide taking photos for them at the stops.

pills.label: No back problems
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not suitable for pregnant women or people with back problems, mobility impairments or epilepsy.

pills.label: Around the Palm
pills.pop_html: Route: Out of the marina and around the Palm Jumeirah, with a pause at Atlantis, then on to the Burj Al Arab and back past the royal palaces.

pills.label: €15 per hour
pills.pop_html: The maths: €22 for 90 minutes works out at about €15 per hour, the lowest hourly price of any speedboat on this page.

pills.label: Water and life jackets
pills.pop_html: On board: A bottle of water is included; there is no food, so eat before you go. Luggage and large bags are not allowed.

pills.label: Fun and fast
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Photo stops at the landmarks and, guests say, real bursts of speed between them.

best_for.pick_html: for budget travellers who still want the full Palm, Atlantis and Burj Al Arab route, because €22 buys 90 minutes and there are departures from 9:00 to 19:45
best_for.skip_html: if anyone in your group has back problems, or if you want the commentary in a language other than English

items.a: 90-minute speedboat tour, guide, bottle of water.

title.text: Dubai Luxury Yacht Tour with Live BBQ Option and Drinks

pills.label: 1, 2 or 3 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: Shared departures leave strictly on time; arrive 30 minutes early, boarding starts 10 minutes before the scheduled start.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Language: Live English-speaking host and tour guide, plus an English audio guide.

pills.label: Life jackets for kids
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Children under 12 must wear the life jacket provided. Not suitable for pregnant women or wheelchair users.

pills.label: Soft drinks included
pills.pop_html: Drinks: Welcome drinks, soft drinks, juices and water on every option. Alcohol is sold at the bar (cash or card).

pills.label: Live BBQ on 2–3 h
pills.pop_html: Food: Breakfast or a live-cooked BBQ on the Burj 2-hour and 3-hour options: burgers, lamb kofta, chicken and halloumi skewers, fruit and muffins.

pills.label: Photographer on board
pills.pop_html: Crew: A photographer, service staff and tour guide sail with you, and you get a free bar drink if you tell them you are celebrating.

pills.label: Polished and social
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A shared yacht from the Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, with a photographer, drinks and the skyline as the point.

best_for.pick_html: for groups who want drinks covered and a live BBQ, because soft drinks, juices and water come on every option and the Burj 2-hour route adds a BBQ cooked on board
best_for.skip_html: if you want food on a 1-hour cruise (BBQ is only on the Burj 2-hour and 3-hour options), or if you are arriving by car and want free parking

items.a: Shared yacht cruise, host and guide, soft drinks, water and juices, music, service staff, captain and crew, life jackets; breakfast or BBQ on the Burj 2-hour and 3-hour options.
Alcoholic drinks (bar), hotel pickup, swimming stops, BBQ on the 1-hour and 2-hour Atlantis Palm options.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Sky Walker Yachts, Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, Dubai International Marine Club.
ID card (copy accepted).

title.text: Dubai 100-Minute Speedboat Tour with Atlantis and Burj Al Arab Views

pills.label: 100 minutes
pills.pop_html: Timing: The longest speedboat ride on the page. Be at Pier 7 at least 15 minutes early; check availability for start times.

pills.label: Arabic and English
pills.pop_html: Language: Live commentary from an English- and Arabic-speaking guide, with a skipper and hostess on every ride.

pills.label: Ages 3+
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not for children under 3, pregnant women, or people with back or heart problems.

pills.label: Max 12 guests
pills.pop_html: Group size: No more than twelve passengers per ride plus skipper and guide, on leather couch-style seats. Seats are assigned on arrival.

pills.label: Burj Al Arab
pills.pop_html: Route: Marina canal, Bluewaters and Ain Dubai, JBR, Skydive Dubai, Atlantis The Palm, Atlantis The Royal, then the Burj Al Arab.

pills.label: Chilled water
pills.pop_html: On board: Complimentary chilled water and professional life jackets on brand-new BSK Marine boats.

pills.label: VIP speedboat
pills.pop_html: Vibe: The smart end of the speedboat market: few seats, personal attention and a top rating from guests.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and small groups who want the full Burj Al Arab route on a comfortable boat with at most 12 guests, because it adds 10 minutes and leather seating over the standard 90-minute tours
best_for.skip_html: if price matters most (the €22 Splash speedboat covers a similar route for half the money), or if you have back problems

items.a: 100-minute cruise in leather seating, English and Arabic commentary, chilled water, life jackets.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Pier 7, Marina Promenade, Dubai Marina.
Max 12 passengers plus skipper and guide.
Passport or ID card, sunglasses, sunscreen, comfortable clothes and shoes.

title.text: Dubai Luxury Sunset Yacht Tour with Light Bites and Drinks

pills.pop_html: Timing: 1.5-hour tour at 15:00 with a light meal, 2-hour sunset tour at 17:00 with light bites, or a 20:00 option with BBQ dinner. Arrive 20 minutes early.

pills.label: English guide
pills.pop_html: Language: Live English-speaking guide; the crew also takes photos for you along the way.

pills.label: Not for seasickness
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not suitable for wheelchair users or people prone to motion sickness. Shoes come off before boarding.

pills.label: Food on every slot
pills.pop_html: Food: Vegetarian or non-vegetarian light meal or light bites, BBQ in the cooler months, and a BBQ dinner of tikka, kebabs and vegetables at 20:00.

pills.label: Soft drinks and water
pills.pop_html: Drinks: Soft drinks and unlimited chilled water included; alcoholic drinks can be bought on board.

pills.label: Toilets and A/C
pills.pop_html: The boat: Air-conditioned lower deck, open-air upper deck and toilet facilities.

pills.label: Golden-hour cruise
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Music, sea breeze and the skyline turning from sunset to lights, with the crew taking photos for you.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want sunset on the water with food included for under €20, because every departure comes with a light meal, light bites or BBQ
best_for.skip_html: if you must see a specific landmark (the route goes to Atlantis or the Burj Al Arab depending on sea conditions), or if you get seasick

items.a: Captain and crew, soft drinks, unlimited water, life jackets, air-conditioned lower deck, toilets; light meal (15:00), light bites (17:00) or BBQ dinner (20:00) by option.
Hotel pickup, alcoholic drinks (sold on board).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Varies by option; exact gate sent by email or WhatsApp the day before or on the day (team in 360 Adventures T-shirts).
Shoes off before boarding.

title.text: Dubai Ride and Slide Yacht Cruise with BBQ Lunch and Drinks

pills.label: 3 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: A daytime cruise: a scenic run along the coast, then a long stop at a sheltered anchorage by the Palm for swimming and lunch.

pills.label: English host
pills.pop_html: Language: An English-speaking host runs the day; this is a party-style cruise, not a guided sightseeing tour.

pills.label: Life jackets for all
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Life jackets for adults and juniors on request. Not suitable for pregnant women or people with mobility impairments. Families rate it highly.

pills.label: Yacht slide
pills.pop_html: Water toys: Inflatable slide off the top deck, sea loungers, paddle board and snorkelling gear in a safe swimming zone.

pills.label: BBQ lunch
pills.pop_html: Food: Beef and chicken burgers, chicken hot dogs, chicken skewers, lamb kofta, veggie burgers, halloumi and vegetable skewers, fruit and muffins.

pills.label: Unlimited drinks
pills.pop_html: Drinks: Unlimited house drinks, cocktails and soft drinks from the bar, plus welcome drinks and music.

pills.label: Beach-club day
pills.pop_html: Vibe: More beach club than boat tour: swim, slide, eat, repeat, with the skyline in the background.

best_for.pick_html: for families and friends who want to swim from a yacht, because it is the only shared cruise here with a swim stop, slide, BBQ lunch and unlimited drinks in the price
best_for.skip_html: if you want sightseeing (it is mostly at anchor near the Palm), or if €80 is more than you want to spend on a boat

items.a: 3-hour yacht cruise, vegetarian and non-veg BBQ lunch, unlimited house drinks and soft drinks, inflatable slide and sea lounger, paddle board and snorkelling gear, music, life jackets.
Hotel pickup and drop-off.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Sky Walker Yachts, Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, Dubai International Marine Club.
Passport or ID card, swimwear, towel, sun hat, sunglasses, goggles, quick-dry clothes.

title.text: Dubai Marina 1-Hour Luxury Sightseeing Speedboat Tour

pills.label: 60 minutes
pills.pop_html: Timing: A one-hour loop from Pier 7; check availability for start times. The operator may move your time for sea conditions.

pills.label: 5 languages
pills.pop_html: Language: Live guide in Arabic, English, French, Greek and Russian, the widest language choice on this page.

pills.label: Seated, ages 3+
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Everyone stays seated inside the boat for the whole ride. Not for under-3s or infants, pregnant women, or people with mobility or heart problems.

pills.label: Ain Dubai and JBR
pills.pop_html: Route: Marina canal, JBR, Ain Dubai on Bluewaters and Skydive Dubai, then a short photo stop at Atlantis The Palm and the Royal Atlantis.

pills.label: Leather seats
pills.pop_html: The boat: Brand-new BSK Marine boat with couch-style leather seating and limited passengers.

pills.label: Chilled water
pills.pop_html: On board: Complimentary chilled water and professional life jackets.

pills.label: Bouncy and quick
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Full speed through the open sea on the way back; the listing itself promises you will bump and whip across the water.

best_for.pick_html: for families and short-on-time visitors who want a quick, comfortable speedboat to Atlantis, because it costs €20 for an hour with guides in five languages
best_for.skip_html: if the Burj Al Arab is the photo you came for (book the 100-minute version), or if you get seasick on choppy water

items.a: 60-minute cruise in leather seating, live commentary, chilled water, life jackets.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Pier 7, Marina Promenade, Dubai Marina.
All passengers seated at all times; no infants.
Passport or ID card, sunglasses, sunscreen, comfortable clothes and shoes.

pills.label: Lively small boat

pills.pop_html: Timing: A one-hour shared cruise; two guests recommend late-evening slots, when it is less crowded and the towers are lit.

pills.label: Virtual guide
pills.pop_html: Language: Virtual guide rather than a live one; the crew hands out the drinks and, guests say, takes photos.

pills.label: No wheelchairs
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not suitable for pregnant women or wheelchair users; electric wheelchairs are not allowed.

pills.label: Ain Dubai and JBR
pills.pop_html: Route: Dubai Marina, Ain Dubai, Bluewaters Island and JBR, with photo stops; no Palm or Burj Al Arab.

pills.label: Tropical drinks

pills.label: Crew photos
pills.pop_html: On board: Several guests say the staff take plenty of photos and videos for them. Wi-Fi is on board.

pills.label: Easy evening hour
pills.pop_html: Vibe: A relaxed, open-deck hour among the Marina towers; good value rather than glamour.

best_for.skip_html: if you want the Palm, Atlantis or the Burj Al Arab, or a live guide
